exactIdCollisions.proposedDirection: Share one technical connector-definition authority; source acquisition may reference it but keeps source-provenance policy separate.
Persistent personal read-later state is not the same implementation as the action that requests it.
Subscription state should originate in entitlement authority; experience context reads a permission-limited projection.
Print rendering/export format and the UI action remain distinct contracts, not two state authorities.

adjacentBoundaryGroups.risk: Creating an independent approval authority outside the Kernel
Duplicated source of truth across schema definition, validator registration and admin projection
Confusing workflow state with Kernel-authorized task execution and operational delivery
Using operational logs as independent approvals or immutable corporate attestations
Policy decisions and computed eligibility could be given inconsistent authority
Conflating source provenance and licensing with technical connector catalog

ownershipPrinciples.limit: No local authority to sign, admit WOs or promote production
Operational evidence is not independent approval or immutable attestation
Event or audit log does not replace evidence and Kernel admission
Display and draft workflow do not grant backend or policy authority

next: Independent source-owner review of each exact collision and boundary group, then versioned canonical ownership map and controlled API contracts before generated service admission.
